cell_type_or_model: IFN-treated cell extracts and ISG promoter elements
assay_or_perturbation: IFN treatment; PCR-assisted binding-site selection; STAT1/STAT2/IRF9 complex and ISRE/GAS binding assays
evidence_summary: ISRE-containing ISGs depend on ISGF3 composed of STAT1, STAT2 and IRF9; STAT2:STAT1 complexes also bind GAS-like elements in a subset of ISGs.
limitations: Comparator biochemical systems; does not establish a specific IFN subtype, receptor complex or SCI receiver-cell target.

cell_type_or_model: p48/IRF9-deficient embryonic fibroblasts and gene-targeted mice
assay_or_perturbation: p48/IRF9 and IRF1 gene targeting; IFN-alpha or IFN-gamma stimulation; ISRE binding and antiviral-state assays
evidence_summary: p48/IRF9 was required for ISRE binding, induction of interferon-responsive genes and antiviral state after type-I and type-II interferon stimulation, with IRF1 providing nonredundant support.
limitations: This establishes transcription-factor complex requirement but does not assign a single ligand-specific terminal target in SCI cells.

cell_type_or_model: IFN-gamma-treated cells; GAS reporter and ChIP/EMSA assays
assay_or_perturbation: IFN-gamma stimulation; IFNGR1 and STAT1 promoter association; GAS reporter activation
evidence_summary: IFN-gamma, IFNGR1 and STAT1 were associated with GAS promoter elements for IFN-gamma-stimulated genes and increased GAS reporter activity.
limitations: The study uses a comparator system and does not resolve the exact endogenous target genes or SCI receiver-cell applicability.

species: human cell lines and mouse/human comparator systems
cell_type_or_model: IFN-beta-treated cells; STAT1/STAT2/IRF9 ChIP and expression assays
assay_or_perturbation: IFN-beta stimulation; STAT/IRF9 phosphorylation and unphosphorylated-complex analyses; antiviral and DNA-damage assays
evidence_summary: IFN-beta-induced ISGF3 drives an early antiviral program and U-ISGF3 supports a prolonged response involving ISRE-associated genes such as OAS2, IFIT1, IFIT3, IFI27 and BST2.
limitations: Delayed U-ISGF3 is mechanistically distinct from the initial phosphorylated ISGF3 relay; do not merge the two as one molecular edge or transfer directly to SCI astrocytes.
